messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer 'acme-eu' (Dedicated) reported that site-admins can't reach /admin after the control-plane deploy. RBAC shows onprem-admin bound but requests are 403 :eyes:. Looks like role-sync didn't apply mappings for that tenant.
ajay: On it. Any logs or error snippets? Could be the role-sync task failed after the deploy.
maria: Pasting the tail of role-sync logs from the target cluster:
```
[2026-03-20T10:12:03Z] role-sync.INFO tenant=acme-eu processing config
[2026-03-20T10:12:03Z] role-sync.ERROR tenant=acme-eu parse_config: invalid key \"network_labels\" (expected object)
[2026-03-20T10:12:03Z] role-sync.WARN tenant=acme-eu skip applying mappings due to validation error
```
ajay: ah — we changed the infra-config schema for network labels (runtime#4301) to accept an array, but role-sync still validates against the old schema (object). That would cause it to skip. When mappings aren't applied the control plane falls back to deny by default.
noah: oncall here — I can do a quick mitigation. Option 1: patch role-sync to accept both formats and re-run for acme-eu. Option 2: add a manual binding via admin API so customer admins can access immediately. Which do you want?
maria: Do both. Manual binding for immediate relief, then patch and re-run. Manual command for control-plane admin API (use admin service token):
```
curl -X POST "https://private-control.acme-eu.redwood.internal/_admin/bindings" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_SVC_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-eu","bindings":[{"role":"onprem-admin","principals":["github:acme/admins"]}] }'
```
noah: I ran the POST, returned 200 OK. Confirmed a few users can now access the UI. Rolling a role-sync patch that adds tolerant schema parsing (accept object OR array) and a migration step. Deploying to staging now.
elaine: I'll add a unit test that covers both legacy and new network_labels formats and add schema validation to CI gating. PR target: today.
ajay: Quick KMS check — yesterday's key rotation completed. I scanned token-verify logs for anomalies; KMS responded OK and there are no signature failures. So KMS rotation isn't the culprit here.
maria: Good to know. I'll open an incident and notify support + the customer with the temporary workaround details. Please include the timeline and root cause.
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0482 — severity P2 — assigned to @ajay, @noah, @maria — incident channel #inc-2026-0482 created.
maria: Follow-ups: (1) sweep all dedicated tenants for legacy network_labels usage (I estimate ~8 tenants), (2) add postmortem once we have timeline, (3) backfill mappings for any tenants that skipped.
noah: Running a quick query to list tenants whose role-sync last_success < last_deploy and where config contains network_labels as array. Will post results in 10m.
elaine: PR opened: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4372 — adds tolerant parser + tests.
ajay: After patch deploy, let's add a monitoring alert: role-sync.apply_rate < 99% or role-sync.validation_errors > 0 should page oncall.
maria: Agreed. I'll add the alert and link the incident. Thanks all. :lock: :white_check_mark:
